**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: cut**

The names carry both facts: k_even is the low half shifted up by BF16_BITS_16 (whose comment in tensor/k_vnni.hpp says 'a bf16 shifted up by this many bits is the exact fp32'), and k_odd is the high half masked by HIGH_HALF_0XFFFF0000 (whose comment says 'the odd value of a dimension pair as an fp32 bit pattern').

Proposed: cut the comment.
